name: Archicad
tagline: Architectural BIM modeling and documentation with strong publishing workflows.
meta_desc: Archicad is common in architectural practices that want model-based documentation and coordination. OpenBIM/IFC usage depends on project standards and exchange agreements.

terms.title: OpenBIM and IFC Collaboration
terms.short_def: Technical best practices for OpenBIM and IFC Collaboration inside Archicad.
terms.definition: OpenBIM and IFC Collaboration supports coordination using buildingSMART specifications, mapping elements accurately.
terms.why_matters: Fosters multi-discipline collaboration without requiring standard software monocultures.
common_pitfalls: Using incorrect IFC translator settings causing parameter loss
Forgetting to align project origins during cross-platform model setup

quiz.question: When working with OpenBIM and IFC Collaboration, which of the following represents a common technical pitfall?
options: Using incorrect IFC translator settings causing parameter loss.
Failing to manually re-index the SQL server database.
Over-allocating virtual memory caches in the cloud settings.
Restricting linetype scales strictly to 1:1 paper coordinates.
quiz.explanation: Correct. A common pitfall is 'Using incorrect IFC translator settings causing parameter loss.' As the editorial review notes: 'Fosters multi-discipline collaboration without requiring standard software monocultures.'

faqs.question: How do I configure hotlinked modules in Archicad?
faqs.answer: Go to File > External Content > Place Hotlinked Module, select the source file (PLN or MOD), and configure translation and layer options.

faqs.question: What is the best way to export IFC files for Revit coordination?
faqs.answer: Use the built-in 'Export to Revit' IFC translator, which optimizes Archicad classification mappings to Revit category classes.

faqs.question: How do I automate layout numbering in Publisher Sets in Archicad?
faqs.answer: Use Archicad's Auto-Text templates in your Master Layouts. The layout book will automatically sequence sheet numbers during publish.
